title: W112 Agent Task Register
source_of_truth: This file is the sole source for W112 Agent Task assignment and execution state. DOC-003 references these stable task IDs; it does not duplicate their state.

tasks.title: Inventory and reconcile Work ownership/source lineage
tasks.deliverable: Owner/source mapping with exact repo, branch, path, base SHA and evidence or explicit blocker
tasks.scope_boundary: Read/trace only; no component source writes or branch creation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every accepted mapping has controlling owner evidence; unknowns remain NOT_SYNCED/BLOCKED
tasks.next_action: Continue from W112 Index Events 007–015; only investigate new source leads

tasks.title: Define and maintain cross-Work contract registry
tasks.deliverable: Reviewed, versioned contract schemas and ownership map
tasks.scope_boundary: Design/review only until W112 DOC-001 and owner Work Entry are approved
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Contracts define producer/consumer, identity, version, required fields and failure behavior
tasks.next_action: Independent review DOC-001 and list findings

tasks.title: Define event and evidence correlation contract
tasks.deliverable: Event envelope, correlation model and evidence provenance requirements
tasks.scope_boundary: No event bus or evidence store implementation; W52/W33 remain owners
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stable IDs, source revision, trace, actor, timestamps and evidence refs are defined
tasks.next_action: Review event/evidence sections in DOC-001 and record architecture findings

tasks.title: Define dependency, idempotency, concurrency and recovery semantics
tasks.deliverable: Dependency readiness, retry, lease, duplicate and recovery contract
tasks.scope_boundary: Design only; no lock provider or runtime enforcement selected
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No silent last-write-wins; retries preserve idempotency; failure and recovery paths are explicit
tasks.next_action: Resolve open decisions and identify owner constraints

tasks.title: Prepare cross-Work integration test harness and verification matrix
tasks.deliverable: Owner-approved contract fixtures, integration test plan and reproducible commands
tasks.scope_boundary: No test execution against live components until endpoint/source and permissions are verified
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests distinguish MOCK/SNAPSHOT/SANDBOX/LIVE and capture raw evidence
tasks.next_action: Prepare test design after DOC-001 review; no live test yet

tasks.title: Independent QE, cross-Work acceptance and release evidence
tasks.deliverable: Independent QE report, acceptance checklist and release evidence dossier
tasks.scope_boundary: Independent verification only; Qw does not approve own implementation; Vinh retains final acceptance
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All results reproducible, scoped and source-pinned; acceptance only after owner approvals
tasks.next_action: Remain pending until implementation and test evidence are available

rules: One accountable role per Agent Task.
Proposed assignment is not dispatch or ACK.
Task status changes require attributable ACK, actual work, deliverable and journal/evidence reference.
The checking agent must be distinct from the primary implementer.
W112 coordinates contracts and verification; component owners retain implementation authority.
